provenance_note: Values transcribed from the exact console output of a run performed by J. Beau (not this session), using the same o15_o1_nogo_verification.py logic (script vendored from quantum-structure/complex-carrier-selection/code/verify_o15_nogo_single.py, identical computation, cosmetic-only differences -- diffed against the vendored copy at commit time). Reported at the script's own print precision (delta_hat/alpha_dyn/ols_slope to 4 decimals, residual in scientific notation); no additional digits are fabricated. total_elapsed_s and bfs_elapsed_s are direct transcriptions of the run's own printed values. Per-block timings are not included here: they carry no scientific result, and reconstructing them by differencing the run's cumulative-elapsed printouts introduced a small (~1.3s, 0.02%) internal inconsistency against total_elapsed_s -- immaterial to any claim in this repository, but not worth retaining an approximate, non-reproduced figure for.
